title: CTO CIS at Breakmark
description_review: Remote CTO-level technical leadership role at an AI agent platform company, combining pre-sales, solution architecture and hands-on engineering leadership. Requires 7-8+ years of engineering, Director/VP/founder-level leadership and fluent English plus a local language; salary not disclosed.
pros: Architecture and enterprise integration leadership matches profile
AI agent platform aligns with applied AI experience
cons: Pre-sales and customer-facing emphasis is heavier than the engineering focus
Stack not specified; Java/Spring not mentioned

title: Global Head of Customer Solutions at Breakmark
description_review: Remote global leadership role running account management and technical support for a payment infrastructure company, leading about 13 people across several countries. Operations-focused rather than hands-on engineering; salary not disclosed.
pros: Enterprise payments context loosely relates to fintech experience
cons: Management of account and support operations, not software engineering
No Java, Spring Boot or architecture scope in the role

title: Forward Deployed Engineer at Breakmark
description_review: Full-time mid-to-senior forward deployed engineer role based on-site in Doha, Dubai or London, building full-stack software with TypeScript, React and Python or Node.js for enterprise and government customers. Requires 2-4 years of full-stack experience; salary not disclosed.
pros: Enterprise customer work and legacy system integration match experience
Full-stack delivery with Python or Node.js fits the stack
cons: Frontend-heavy TypeScript/React focus rather than Java/Spring backend
Requires on-site presence in Doha, Dubai or London

title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops) at StellDirVor GmbH
description_review: Early-stage ML engineering role in Munich focused on computer vision models, ML operations and generative AI for medical training in AR smart glasses. Hands-on data and model work in a small team; salary and experience requirements not disclosed.
pros: Applied generative AI experience is relevant
cons: Computer vision and ML-specific skills are outside the core Java/Spring profile
Healthcare domain rather than banking/fintech or enterprise backend

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (f/m/x) at LiveEO GmbH
description_review: Senior full-stack engineering role in Berlin (hybrid) on the SurfaceScout satellite analytics product, owning features end to end in TypeScript and Python and shaping architecture and integrations. Senior technical leadership within a squad; salary not disclosed.
pros: Senior ownership and architecture responsibilities match seniority
Designing integrations and reliable services aligns with microservices experience
cons: TypeScript and Python stack rather than Java/Spring Boot
Satellite analytics domain is outside banking/fintech
